svg.title: What an open does after a crash
svg.desc: Opening a store loads its last snapshot, then replays every WAL record committed after that snapshot's checkpoint. A damaged record before the end of the WAL stops the open with a storage error. A record the crash cut short at the very end is dropped. A writable open then trims that record from the file and checkpoints when it exits; a read-only open leaves the files as they are.
